sentences.text: IBAC’s Operation Turton investigated alleged unauthorised access to and disclosure of information at the former Metropolitan Fire Brigade.
sentences.support: Operation Turton investigated allegations of unauthorised access and disclosure of information

sentences.text: IBAC identified five incidents and found weaknesses in information security and workplace culture.
sentences.support: IBAC identified five separate incidents where MFB information was accessed or disclosed without authorisation

sentences.text: It concluded that information was accessed or disclosed without authority, often to advance union interests, and identified barriers to reporting and addressing improper conduct.
sentences.support: IBAC also found barriers for reporting improper conduct and for management to address issues

sentences.text: IBAC made four recommendations to Fire Rescue Victoria on consultation, information security, sharing information with unions and internal complaints.
sentences.support: IBAC is making four recommendations to FRV to strengthen its information security infrastructure

findings.quote: Operation Turton found deficiencies in MFB’s culture and vulnerabilities in its information and communication technology (ICT) systems, contributing to significant corruption risks.
IBAC also found barriers for reporting improper conduct and for management to address issues.

notes: The four recommendations are directed to Fire Rescue Victoria because MFB employees and systems transferred to it. The summary does not adopt witness accounts as findings.
